list.summary:
A summary longer than three lines is clipped to its first three, with **more** after it, so the rows stay in view. Read Summary in the action panel (⌘K), or a click on more, opens the whole summary as a page, with every fact as the page's metadata.

That page is a pushed screen like any other: ⌘[ comes back to the rows, and Return on it copies the text. Up to four facts show in the strip above the rows; this list sends six, so the last two are only on the summary page.

A summary of three lines or fewer, or one above at most three rows with room to spare, always shows whole.
